subject: Insurance
title: Beneficiaries: Who Gets the Money
description: A fast breakdown of Beneficiaries: Who Gets the Money for builders.

hook.text: You choose your beneficiary—the person who gets paid when you die. Change it after a divorce or the ex gets everything.

buildup.text: Beneficiaries can be anyone: a spouse, child, charity, or business partner.

discovery.text: Life insurance payouts bypass probate. The beneficiary gets paid directly, often within days.

twist.text: Outdated beneficiary forms cause lawsuits every year. People forget to update after marriage, divorce, or birth.

climax.text: Naming a beneficiary is the most important decision in life insurance. The wrong name means the wrong person gets paid.

punchline.text: Update your beneficiary. The wrong name sends the money to the wrong person.

quiz.question: What happens if you don't update your life insurance beneficiary after divorce?
options: Your ex-spouse may receive the payout
The money goes to the government
